scope.evidence_basis: Actual author reconstruction: The constant sequence 1/j retains bounded Holder norms while losing positivity. The cosine sequence has a nonvanishing alpha quotient at 0 and pi/n, so alpha-norm convergence fails although second derivatives converge uniformly. The L2-weak sine sequence has squared integral pi; it invalidates automatic passage of squares from weak convergence. Translated compactly supported bumps verify that local convergence does not imply global sup convergence.
